name: Havells India Ltd

ledger.quote: We have been working closely with our channel to increase consumer offtake, and we believe that the channel inventories will normalize by the end of Q3.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: Normalize channel inventories by end of Q3
ledger.verdict: Promised channel inventory normalization by end of Q3 FY26, but management did not update on it.

ledger.quote: FY 25-26 will be about INR1,450 crores. FY 26-27, right now, it's estimated about INR1,000 crores, but we'll know the exact numbers by end of March.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: FY27 capex estimated at INR1,000 crores
ledger.verdict: FY27 capex target remains pending as execution continues through FY27.
ledger.evidence: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.quote: So ECD continuously, there will be aspiration for growth and improvement of margins.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: ECD margin target has no timeline and reported numbers do not break down segment margins.

ledger.quote: And going forward also, in the coming year also, we do feel that there is enough opportunity in the solar segment to continue to grow.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Renewable solar segment continued growing with healthy contributions in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: During the quarter, each of our categories grew, with healthy contributions from both our established categories, including cables and switchgear, as well as the emerging renewables category.

ledger.quote: So hopefully by the end of this year early next year first quarter we'll be having the entire capacity which was planned.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Planned capacity target was partly achieved with full expansion now expected in 18 months.
ledger.evidence: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.quote: Yes I think by '27-'28 major capex would go into cables and wires which is already panned out.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: major capex into cables and wires
ledger.verdict: Major capex into cables and wires remains pending towards the FY27-28 target timeline.
ledger.evidence: And as we as we indicated, that most of the expansion is on the MV and the EHV side. So, that's playing out to what we had sort of explained when we started this expansion journey.

ledger.quote: And I think this is -- a lot of that is happening in this financial year also, INR800 crores.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: Target of INR800 crore capex for FY27 remains pending as the financial year is ongoing.
ledger.evidence: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.quote: And that will happen over the next two, two and a half years. There is no major new capex in the Lloyd segment.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: R&D centre over next two, two and a half years
ledger.by_when: next two, two and a half years
ledger.verdict: R&D center setup remains pending within its two to two-and-a-half-year implementation window.
ledger.evidence: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.quote: Hopefully, in the next couple of years, we should continue to grow even in the B2C segment, especially where we see a lot of growth opportunity in Lloyd and ECD.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: B2C segment growth continued, aiding a 34.6% YoY overall revenue expansion in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: Revenue Sep 2026 Rs 6432.0 crore, YoY growth 34.6%

ledger.quote: So we are very confident that Q2 will see a good growth in the international and overall switchgear segment.
ledger.speaker: Rajiv Goel
ledger.verdict: Switchgear segment delivered healthy double-digit volume growth in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: And I think, overall, volume growth has also been healthy, closer to double digits, because switchgear value growth is not the same as cables wires, so switchgear volume growth has also been healthy.

ledger.quote: As they grow, we are expecting to grow our contribution and overall profitability much higher than the value growth in sales itself.
ledger.speaker: Rajiv Goel
ledger.verdict: Profitability growth lagged value growth in Q2 FY27, with EBITDA up 30.8% versus 34.6% revenue growth.
ledger.evidence: Revenue YoY % 34.6%, EBITDA YoY % 30.8%, PAT YoY % 9.7%

ledger.quote: All this has happened also due to the volatility and timing differences between passing price hikes and all that. But otherwise, in full quarters, we will definitely see it coming back to double digits.
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.verdict: OPM in Q2 FY27 was 9.0%, missing the committed double-digit margin level.

ledger.quote: So the way we look at it is that Lloyd spends on A&P will remain elevated for the next couple of years because there is a dual requirement of also premiumizing the brand in the product categories
ledger.speaker: Anil Rai Gupta
ledger.target: elevated A&P spends for next couple of years
ledger.verdict: Lloyd A&P spends remained elevated and on budget through H1 FY27 as committed.
ledger.evidence: First quarter, we pulled in a lot of advertising spends, and second quarter has been more in line with our budgeted spends.

open.quote: RAC continues to be the large part of the business, close to almost 75%. And hopefully, over a period of time, we want to bring it to around 60% with growth in the non-RAC products.
open.speaker: Rajiv Goel

read: Management demonstrates strong execution on volume and top-line growth across switchgear, B2C, and renewables categories. However, margin commitments and overall profitability growth continue to lag revenue growth due to commodity cost pressures.
questions: When will overall operating profit margins return to double-digit levels following 9.0% in Q2 FY27?
Why did Q2 FY27 EBITDA growth of 30.8% lag revenue growth of 34.6% despite operating leverage?
What caused the full capacity expansion timeline to extend by 18 months?
bull: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 34.6% YoY to Rs 6,432 crore on broad category expansion.
Switchgear volume growth achieved double digits while contribution margins recovered to 38-39%.
Renewables segment scaled up with healthy top-line and margin contributions.
bear: Q2 FY27 OPM remained stuck at 9.0%, missing promised double-digit margin levels.
Operating profit growth of 30.8% lagged total revenue growth of 34.6% in Q2 FY27.
Full capacity expansion timelines have been extended by up to 18 months.
